label: Proteoglycan/GAG and O-glycan synthesis and degradation
reason: GAG biosynthesis and MPS lysosomal degradation plus dystroglycan/Notch O-glycosylation, linked by Golgi glycan assembly and lysosomal glycan turnover; few odd members.

label: Myelination and axon-glia nodal organisation
reason: CNS/PNS myelin formation, paranodal junctions, neurofascin/L1-ankyrin and Na channel clustering for conduction.

label: Steroid hormone and fat-soluble vitamin metabolism
reason: Adrenal/gonadal steroidogenesis plus vitamin A, D, K metabolism, linked by CYP-mediated sterol/isoprenoid hormone biochemistry and nuclear-receptor ligands.

label: Collagen and elastic fibre ECM assembly
reason: Collagen synthesis, crosslinking and fibril organisation plus elastic fibres; fibrinogen levels is a lone odd member.

label: Phosphate homeostasis and NaPi transport
reason: SLC34 Na/Pi cotransporters, FGF23-Klotho, PTH response and bone mineralisation all regulate phosphate balance.

label: Th2 / type 2 immunity (IL-4, IL-5, IL-13, IL-33)
reason: Th2 differentiation, type 2 cytokine production, IL-33 alarmin, mast cells and anti-nematode response.

label: Hepatic drug and bilirubin disposition transport
reason: SLCO/ABCC organic anion transport, UGT glucuronidation, heme/bilirubin catabolism and drug ADME form one xenobiotic-clearance theme.

label: Nucleotide-sugar supply for glycoconjugate synthesis
reason: UDP-GlcNAc, GDP-fucose, CMP-sialic acid synthesis and SLC35 transport plus GPI anchor synthesis, all glycosylation precursor biology.

label: Visceral smooth muscle contraction and tachykinins
reason: GI, uterine, urinary and penile smooth muscle contraction linked by tachykinin receptor signalling; mating/insemination via erection.

label: RIG-I/MDA5-IRF3 type I interferon antiviral signalling
reason: Cytosolic RNA sensing, IRF3/IRF7 activation and IFN-alpha/beta production with their regulators.

label: Nuclear RNA transcription and processing
reason: Ribosome biogenesis/Pol I-III transcription and mRNA splicing/3' processing, linked by shared nuclear RNA processing machinery (snRNPs, exosome) and MYC targets.

label: Chondrogenesis and osteoblast bone development
reason: RUNX2, chondrocyte differentiation/hypertrophy, ossification and skeletal morphogenesis with BMP/Wnt drivers.

label: Pol I rRNA transcription and ribosome biogenesis
reason: RNA Pol I initiation/elongation/termination, rDNA chromatin regulation, rRNA processing and MYC growth targets.

label: Autophagosome and endosome fusion with lysosomes
reason: Autophagosome maturation, phagosome/MVB/late endosome to lysosome fusion and trafficking.

label: Centrosome, spindle orientation and cilium regulation
reason: Centriole duplication, MTOC nucleation, spindle positioning and centriole-derived cilium assembly/disassembly.

label: Nucleotide-sugar supply for glycoconjugate synthesis
reason: Nucleotide-sugar biosynthesis and Golgi SLC35 transport, sialic acid and GPI anchor synthesis, with their CDG defects.

label: Purine nucleotide de novo synthesis and salvage
reason: PRPP, IMP/AMP/GMP synthesis and HPRT/APRT salvage pathways.

label: Forebrain and cerebellar neurodevelopment and migration
reason: Neural progenitor division, radial glia, cortical layering and neuronal migration in brain development.

label: Epidermal and skin appendage development
reason: Keratinocyte differentiation, cornification, skin barrier and hair follicle/sebaceous/nail development; few odd members.

label: rRNA processing, modification and nuclear RNA surveillance
reason: snoRNP-guided rRNA modification, pre-rRNA cleavages and exosome-mediated RNA decay/surveillance.

label: Mucopolysaccharidosis GAG lysosomal degradation
reason: All members are lysosomal degradation of CS/DS/HS GAGs and the MPS disorders.

label: Selective autophagy pathways
reason: Mitophagy, pexophagy, aggrephagy, microautophagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy.

label: Ciliary trafficking and intraflagellar transport
reason: IFT, BBSome, ARL13B and transition zone targeting of cargo to the cilium.

label: Late mitosis: cytokinesis and nuclear envelope remodelling
reason: Cleavage furrow, abscission and spindle midzone with NE disassembly/reformation (ESCRT-III sealing) during M phase.

label: Germline: meiosis, gametes, piRNA and oocyte-to-embryo
reason: Meiotic recombination/segregation, spermatogenesis, piRNA transposon silencing and maternal-zygotic transition, linked by germline biology.

label: Collagen, elastic fibre and basement membrane ECM
reason: Collagen trimerisation, crosslinking, anchoring fibrils, elastic fibres and basement membrane assembly.

label: Protein glycosylation and GAG biosynthesis
reason: Golgi O-/N-glycan, GAG chain, fucosylation, sialylation and blood-group antigen synthesis with CDG/dystroglycanopathy defects.

label: Regulation of cell migration and matrix adhesion
reason: Rho/Rac control of lamellipodia, focal adhesion turnover, epithelial/fibroblast migration and wound spreading.

label: Heterogeneous signalling and development grab-bag
reason: Sample spans oncogenic receptor mutants, neural, cardiac, erythroid, circadian and ciliary terms with no common theme.

label: SLC solute transport: amino acids, urate, organic ions
reason: Plasma-membrane SLC carriers for amino acids, peptides, urate and organic ions and their renal transport disorders.

label: Keratinocyte differentiation and cornification
reason: Epidermal keratinocyte proliferation/differentiation, cornified envelope and skin barrier.

label: Peroxisomal fatty acid alpha/beta oxidation
reason: VLCFA, phytanate and pristanate oxidation, ABCD1/ALD and peroxisomal processing.

label: Transition metal ion homeostasis and detoxification
reason: Zinc, copper, manganese and cadmium transport, MTF1/metallothionein responses.

label: Ureteric bud and nephric duct development
reason: Mesonephric/nephric duct, ureteric bud elongation and renal vesicle formation.

label: Axon regeneration and glial myelination
reason: Axon sprouting/regeneration and growth inhibition plus myelination and reactive gliosis, linked by axon-glia interactions in nerve injury and repair.

label: B cell activation, germinal centre and plasma cells
reason: B cell signatures, proliferation, GC/Tfh differentiation, plasma cells and humoral memory.

label: Endolysosomal and autophagosome-lysosome fusion
reason: Autophagosome maturation, endosome/phagosome/MVB fusion with lysosomes and endolysosome size control.

label: ER proteostasis: UPR, ISR and ER protein targeting
reason: IRE1/PERK/ATF6 UPR, eIF2 kinase stress responses, ERAD and SRP/tail-anchored ER insertion.

label: Angiogenesis and endothelial VEGF regulation
reason: Sprouting angiogenesis, endothelial proliferation/migration and VEGF/FGF production regulation.

label: Canonical and non-canonical NF-kB signalling
reason: IKK/NIK activation, TNFR1/CD40 signalling, linear ubiquitination and IKK deficiency disorders.
